caveat: Timeframe alignment is descriptive. A conflict between timeframes is the normal state of a market, not an error, and alignment has not been shown to precede better returns.
narrative: 1w: bearish, mid range · 1d: range · 4h: range, near range top · 1h: transition, below range · 15m: range, upper third. The higher timeframe holds a direction while a lower one consolidates - a pause inside a move rather than a disagreement.

timeframes.invalidation: A 1w close outside 23237.04-126950.27 would invalidate the current range reading.
A 4h close above 81541.64 would break the range top zone and invalidate the current range reading.
A 1h close back above 79595.77 would mean the breakdown failed and price has reintegrated the range.
A 15m close above 80036.74 would break the range top zone and invalidate the current range reading.
